en.headline: Average wages rise 3.4 percent in June, Census says
en.dek: Real wages were up 1.6 percent after inflation, and payroll per person engaged climbed 3.5 percent in the second quarter.
body: The Census and Statistics Department said the average wage rate across selected industries, measured by the wage index, rose 3.4 percent in nominal terms in June 2026 from a year earlier.

After discounting consumer prices as measured by the Consumer Price Index (A), overall real wages increased 1.6 percent. About 62 percent of companies reported higher average wage rates than a year earlier, 33 percent recorded a decrease and 5 percent reported virtually no change. Nominal wage indices rose in every selected industry section, by between 2.4 percent and 4.2 percent.

The index of payroll per person engaged for all surveyed industries increased 3.5 percent in nominal terms in the second quarter from a year earlier. After deflating by the Composite Consumer Price Index, real payroll per person engaged rose 1.6 percent. Nominal payroll indices advanced in all selected sections by 2.0 percent to 5.3 percent.

A government spokesman said wages and labour earnings continued to increase solidly in the second quarter, with the rise broad-based across industries. Wage growth is expected to remain positive as the local economy expands and labour demand holds up, the spokesman said, while the Government will watch external uncertainties.

zh.headline: 統計處：6月平均工資率按年升3.4%
zh.dek: 扣除通脺後實質工資升1.6%；第二季從業員平均薪金名義升3.5%、實質升1.6%。
body: 政府統計處公布，以工資指數計算，選定行業主類在2026年6月的平均工資率較上年同期名義上升3.4%。
扣除以甲類消費物價指數計算的物價變動後，整體實質平均工資率上升1.6%。約62%公司的平均工資率較上年上升，33%下跌，其餘5%幾乎沒有變動。所有選定行業主類的名義工資指數均錄得按年升幅，介乎2.4%至4.2%。
所有調查行業的從業員平均薪金指數，在2026年第二季較上年同期名義上升3.5%；扣除綜合消費物價指數後，實質升幅為1.6%。各選定行業主類的名義平均薪金指數升幅介乎2.0%至5.3%。
政府發言人表示，第二季工資及勞工收入繼續穩健上升，升幅遍及各行業。展望未來，本地經濟持續擴張應可支持勞工需求，工資增長料維持正向，當局會繼續留意外圍不明朗因素。
